_comment: A SYNTHETIC playbook, for tests only. Deliberately not the real one — the real one is
editorial and lives in the private notes repo. This file exists to prove the loading,
templating and blank-preserving behaviour without putting any marketing copy in a
public repository, which is the whole point of the split.
Every string here is nonsense on purpose. If it ever starts reading like real copy,
someone has moved the plan back into the open.
alert_act_now: FIXTURE act-now advice for {name}, window ~2 h.
copy_header: FIXTURE COPY SCAFFOLDS <angle brackets are yours>

scaffolds.title: FIXTURE typo block
lines: a deliberate {not_a_real_field} that must survive rendering
